annotations.title: Generate GovCon Black-Hat Competitive Review & Ethical Ghosting Statements

description: Conduct a Shipley Black-Hat competitive intelligence simulation on a target solicitation and incumbent contractor, returning a Black-Hat executive assessment with unseating probability (0-100%), simulated competitor Black-Hat profiles (predicted bid strategy, pricing/wrap-rate posture, exploitable vulnerabilities, and counter-strategies), paste-ready Shipley ethical ghosting statements mapped to RFP Section L/M evaluation factors, an incumbent recompete vulnerability matrix (transition risk neutralizer, technical debt exposure, PTW wrap-rate wedge, and Contracting Officer shaping questions), and Red Team evaluator scoring triggers. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive capture intelligence generator (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `solicitation_and_incumbent_context_text` accepts 20 to 45,000 characters, while `bidder_discriminators_and_proof_points` and `evaluation_type_and_posture` tailor ghosting prose across Best-Value Tradeoff and LPTA competitions). Use this tool when running a pre-RFP or pre-proposal Black-Hat competitive review to expose incumbent weaknesses and draft Shipley ethical ghosting language; use `match_capability_statement` instead for an initial Gate-1 Bid/No-Bid Pwin score, or `generate_igce_price_to_win` for quantitative LCAT and wrap-rate sensitivity modeling.

bidder_discriminators_and_proof_points.description: Bidder's technical discriminators, proprietary accelerators, past performance metrics, socio-economic status, and wrap-rate / PTW advantages (defaults to 'Cleared_Automation_First_Team_With_Zero_Trust_cATO_And_Lower_Wrap_Rate').

evaluation_type_and_posture.description: Capture posture and source selection method (e.g., Challenger Unseating Incumbent under Best-Value Tradeoff, Incumbent Defending Recompete, or LPTA; defaults to 'Challenger_Unseating_Incumbent_Best_Value_Tradeoff').

solicitation_and_incumbent_context_text.description: Target RFP scope, Section M evaluation weights, incumbent contractor name/PIID, historical award ceiling, known incumbent pain points (SLA misses, turnover, legacy tech debt), and likely competitor bidders (20 to 45,000 characters).

name: generate_capture_black_hat_review

black_hat_executive_assessment.description: High-level Black-Hat competitive intelligence summary, unseating probability, and primary win strategy.

competitor_black_hat_profiles.description: Simulated Black-Hat profiles for the incumbent and top challenger archetypes with exploitable vulnerabilities and counter-strategies.

incumbent_recompete_vulnerability_matrix.description: Tactical playbook neutralizing incumbent transition advantages, exposing technical debt, and shaping Q&A amendments.

red_team_evaluator_scoring_triggers.description: Concrete proof points and callout boxes designed to earn formal SSEB 'Significant Strengths' under FAR 15.305.

shipley_ethical_ghosting_statements.description: Paste-ready Shipley ethical ghosting statements mapped to RFP Section L/M evaluation factors.

title: Generate GovCon Black-Hat Competitive Review & Ethical Ghosting Statements
